description: Type the 422 with `error.code` TENANT_INFRA_NOT_READY as DatabaseNotReady on ingestContext and query. HydraDB's agent guide (https://docs.hydradb.com/AGENTS.md, section 12) documents it: '422 | semantic validation failure, including TENANT_INFRA_NOT_READY | Only for TENANT_INFRA_NOT_READY, after polling readiness' and 'TENANT_INFRA_NOT_READY | 422: the database exists but its infrastructure is still provisioning. This is what querying before polling readiness returns'; section 4 makes polling GET /databases/status the step before ingesting. The spec lists 422 on POST /context/ingest but not on POST /query, and types both only as the shared envelope. It is a client error, not retried by the default policy: poll getDatabaseStatus until `infra.ready_for_ingestion`, then call again. No live response was recorded (no API key yet).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The database exists but its infrastructure is still provisioning (HydraDB TENANT_INFRA_NOT_READY, HTTP 422). Poll `getDatabaseStatus` until `infra.ready_for_ingestion` is true, then retry.
